column1: # Provisional game profile of My Time at Sandrock (Switch, update 1.4.2.0 = v851968 over the base game), Unity 2021.3.26f1 IL2CPP, SDK 16.2.0, NVN, Wwise.
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Written from a survey of the game files (dm/games/profile_guess.py); packed on a PC, not run on a device. Every key marked "guess" follows a rule or a sibling
# profile and is not measured. README.md beside this file.
# guess: a 3D game with a free camera; the 3D layout has the right stick. Nothing in the files decides it
# 1.4.2.0: the update's control data (control.nacp +0x3060); the base package says 1.0.2 and has no main of its own
# every module main imports from; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie
# the file every Unity player has (as the other Unity profiles); profile_guess.py's rule would name the largest file, an asset bundle
# The borrowed 1.5 GB pool fills during character creation on Android/Turnip: MapPhysicalMemory is refused at 1.43 GB mapped, then main+0x52b780 writes an
# allocator header into uncommitted memory. Restore the standard application pool and grow the alias region and reserve together: nninitStartup reserves
# pool-minus-used as one address region, so raising the pool alone would take address space Unity also needs (Sea of Stars, same SDK).
# Keep the existing 256 MB stack and 384 MB heap partitions. These sizes pass the opening character scene; later gameplay remains unverified.
# the NPDM declares 6 MB of system resource
# Frame rate: FPSLocker Warehouse lists this exact build as needing no code patch above 30. Follow display ticks so the host's cap can select 30 or 60;
# use the requested 60 fps default. Higher targets depend on the scene and device. No fixed-step or engine-memory patch is used.
# No mem_used: for a game with a system resource the NSP script leaves it to the heap check (refine_after_rewrite). The rewritten modules are 155 MB, more than
# the default 64 MB: if the first run logs "[mem] SetHeapSize ... + modules ... > app pool" and no heap after it, the key is mem_used 0x9e98000
# (profile_guess.mem_used on the pack). Sea of Stars runs without the key
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----
